introHtml: Custom Halloween jar openers make memorable giveaways for trunk-or-treat events, office costume parties, or safety-themed trick-or-treating. Unlike generic jar openers, these feature festive Halloween designs in orange, black, or glow-in-the-dark finishes. Choose from plastic or silicone construction, and add your logo or a spooky message via pad printing or laser engraving. They're practical for all ages and easy to distribute in bulk.
